title: dfilter: Add memory cell object
description:
Replace the GSList representation of register memory
with a df_cell_t object.

This should increase type safety and readability of the code.

The internal pointer array implementation is also presumed to
be better than a list in terms of performance and memory locality.

Also it matches the internal representation of "interesting fields".

commits_data.title: dfilter: Remove attempted load array
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Remove attempted load array

The cell states null and empty are different. We do not need the
attempted load array anymore. An attempted load is made if the
memory cell is not null (it may be empty if the tree field does
not exist).
